title: Naturality of the actual derived completion unit
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J and commutative ring sheaf O, and assume its unbounded derived category. For any complex K of O-module sheaves and any augmentation epsilon:K→O[0], use the actual completion functor L_K=RHom(K,-) and completion unit eta of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-completion-unit]. For every derived morphism g:E→Eprime, eta_E followed by L_K(g) equals g followed by eta_Eprime. No finiteness, boundedness, ideal, or completeness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 099F, proposition-derived-completion, completion unit induced by the augmented complex; sites-cohomology.tex Section 08J7, section-internal-hom, derived internal Hom

proof.text: 1. Evaluation at one is a natural complex isomorphism from Hom(O[0],I) to I. Compose the functorial K-injective replacement map, its inverse evaluation, and the localization factorization. Naturality of these three maps gives a natural transformation on complexes.

2. Fully faithful whiskering by localization descends this transformation. Naturality at the chosen representative isomorphism shows that its components equal the actual ringedDerivedHomUnit on every derived object.

3. In the internal-Hom bifunctor, precomposition with epsilon commutes with postcomposition by g. Compose that square with naturality of ringedDerivedHomUnit to obtain the displayed completion-unit equality.

lean.statement:
theorem completion_unit_natural
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))]
    (K : ringedSiteComplex O) (ε : K ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex O)
    (E E' : ringedSiteDerived O) (g : E ⟶ E') :
    ringedCechCompletionUnit O K ε E ≫ (ringedCechCompletionFunctor O K).map g =
      g ≫ ringedCechCompletionUnit O K ε E'
